key_insight: BRIDGE provides paired prostate biopsy whole-slide images across three preparation stages to support label-free virtual staining research.
clinical_relevance: The dataset enables research on computational staining and prostate cancer grading concordance, but does not establish clinical readiness.
method: Sequentially scan each slide in paraffin, after deparaffinization, and after H&E staining.
Pair images across preparation stages for virtual staining, registration, and segmentation research.
Include a Gleason score for each slide to support classification and grading analyses.
evidence_signal: The dataset contains 2,607 whole-slide images from 869 slides belonging to 169 patients at one Polish oncology centre; the abstract reports no model performance results.
watch_item: Single-centre sourcing may limit generalizability; clinical use would require independent validation.
paper_title: The BRIDGE dataset: paired brightfield whole-slide images of prostate core-needle biopsies in paraffin, after deparaffinization and H&E staining
